description: You're participating in NaNoWriMo (50,000 words in 30 days). It's Day 18, and you've switched from Project Alpha to Project Beta mid-challenge. Open /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/nano_wordcount_raw.xlsx containing messy word count data with multiple daily entries. Create a consolidated progress dashboard showing: (1) total words written, (2) current daily average, (3) words remaining, (4) required daily pace for the remaining 12 days, (5) status (ON TRACK or BEHIND). Use formulas, bold headers, and color-code the status. Save with Ctrl+S.
